name: On-map skirmish exchange
oneLiner: The attack exchange plays on the map itself instead of cutting to a side-view scene (the alternative to A-04 clash-cutin): the small map units fight in place. The attacker lunges 2-3 px toward its target but never enters its tile, the hit spark lands on the target's side that faces the attacker, only the target flashes a solid white silhouette for 2-3 frames, shows an opaque hurt pose and is knocked back 2 px, the damage number pops above its head where it covers no other unit, a miss sweeps a white arc and shows MISS while the target sidesteps, the counter-attack and a follow-up for the side at least 4 speed faster play in turn, both HP plates sit at the bottom of the screen (or the top when units stand there) and drain slowly, and a boss braces in place instead of lunging. The game passes the outcome it already decided; the module only stages it.
fits: tactics / strategy RPG on a grid map (attack + counter exchanges)
turn-based map game that wants quick exchanges without leaving the map
a game whose separate battle screen should be replaced by fighting on the map
wargame or skirmish game with a 'map animations' option
notFor: real-time action games (the exchange pauses the world)
attacks that hit many units at once (stage one pair per exchange)
games that want a dramatic close-up: use A-04 clash-cutin instead (same family, pick one)

needs: the moment the game has confirmed a single-target attack and resolved it with its own rules: attacker and defender, each strike in order (who strikes, hit / miss / crit, damage) and both HP values after
each fighter's id, name, team, HP before, max HP and its sprite box on screen as drawn now (native px), optionally `boss: true`
the place where the game draws each unit (route it through drawActor so the lunge, flash, hurt pose and knock-back show), the other units' rects (getObstacles) and the HUD's rects (uiRects)
a fixed update step and a place to pause the game's world, autoplay and input while busy() is true
provides: onDone({att, def, skipped, ko}) when the exchange has closed: apply the HP and resume the game there
onImpact({i, by, target, result, dmg, after, ko}) once per strike when it lands (sound, rumble)
order({attSpd, defSpd, gap, counter}) -> ['att', 'def', 'att'] (counter and a follow-up for the side at least `gap` faster)
busy(), fighting(id), facing(id), dir(id), offset(id), gone(id), state()

assets: module/on-map-skirmish.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_OnMapSkirmish): timeline, lunge / knock-back / sidestep / brace offsets, solid white flash and opaque hurt tint through an offscreen layer, code-drawn hit sparks, swish arcs, KO shards, a 5x8 pixel font for numbers, MISS and plates, team and boss HP plates with a slow drain, placement of numbers and plates away from units and HUD
no image or audio files: fighters are the game's own sprites; the demo's map units are hand-pixelled in code (src/cast.js)
